_comment: Names of exception vectors by vector number (hex). Module vectors follow the set-up in the reset code: PICR PIV = $38 (PIT), GPT ICR IVBA = 4 (vectors $40-$4B; ICR IPA = $B makes the pulse accumulator input the adjusted channel, so it is served by vector $40), QIVR = $FE (SCI $FE, QSPI $FF). Vectors $11-$17 are the IRQ1-IRQ7 autovectors.
